id.description: The full id of the document.

documentId.description: The id of the document. json-ld type:schema:identifier

documentIdFormat.description: The format of the document id. json-ld type:schema:Text

documentCode.description: The code for the document type. json-ld type:schema:identifier

documentRevision.description: The revision of the document as a 0 based index. json-ld type:schema:Integer

annotationObject.description: Additional annotation information for the document. json-ld namespace:twin-common

blobStorageId.description: The blob storage id for the document. json-ld type:schema:identifier

blobHash.description: The hash of the blob data. json-ld namespace:twin-common

blobStorageEntry.description: The additional JSON-LD for blob storage if it was requested. json-ld id

extractedData.description: The data extracted from the document using data extraction services. json-ld type:json

attestationId.description: The attestation for the document if one was created. json-ld type:schema:identifier

attestationInformation.description: The additional JSON-LD for attestation storage if it was requested. json-ld id

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the document was created. json-ld namespace:schema

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the document was modified. json-ld namespace:schema

dateDeleted.description: The date/time of when the document was deleted, as we never actually remove items. json-ld namespace:schema

organizationIdentity.description: The organization which added the document to the graph. json-ld namespace:twin-common

userIdentity.description: The user who added the document to the graph. json-ld namespace:twin-common
